title: LPLC2 looming detectors -> giant fiber -> escape takeoff
label: RECORDED simulation replay - not a live re-computation

brain.model: flylab.brain: whole-brain LIF after Shiu et al. 2024 (Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9), FlyWire v783
brain.note: Mean firing rate per neuron over the brain run (not time-resolved). Open loop: the brain run precedes the body run and receives no sensory feedback.

explain.thrust_applies_only_when_airborne: flylab.flight beats the wings only after a takeoff trigger; without GF-driven takeoff the thrust value has no effect
explain.formula: a=min(1,rate/ref); takeoff=mean(a(GF_L),a(GF_R)) [flight if >= 0.5]; thrust=a(DNg02 population); yaw=clip(1.0*dDNa02+0.5*dDNa01,-1,1) [transfer assumption]; pitch=0
explain.connectome_decides: takeoff trigger (GF), wingbeat-amplitude increment (DNg02), left/right steering asymmetry
explain.hand_designed: jump impulse, wing kinematics, attitude/heading stabilisation, baseline flight-motor drive, quasi-steady aerodynamics (flylab.flight.model_notes())

frozen.note: Parameters are frozen before the comparison runs (team rule G3). The validation JSON records the hash; a changed hash means the adapter was modified after the comparison.

explain.note: hand-designed VNC replacement (FlyWire covers the brain only); open loop, constant command from time-averaged rates

bridge.frozen: flylab.bridge mapping is hand-designed and fixed before these runs (ventral nerve cord not simulated)

model_notes.body: FlyBody (Vaxenburg et al. 2025, Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-025-09029-4), original fruitfly.xml from flygym 2.1 with full-size meshes; MuJoCo rigid-body physics, ground contact, gravity.
model_notes.approach: B: wingbeat-cycle-averaged quasi-steady aerodynamics applied as forces/torques (mj_applyFT); MuJoCo fluid model off. Approach A (MuJoCo fluid forces on flapping wings) not completed in the time box.
physics: rigid-body dynamics of the whole fly (MuJoCo, dt 0.1 ms)
quasi-steady mean lift L = 0.5 rho C_L S <U2^2> per wing at a centre of pressure (roll/pitch torques emerge from left/right lift difference and fore/aft centre-of-pressure shift)
wing joint servo dynamics (wings flap at 200 Hz; visual realism, no fluid force from them)
hand_designed: trim: baseline amplitude solved for lift = weight
thrust -> amplitude: Phi = Phi_hover * (1 + 0.12 * thrust), max 170 deg
attitude stabiliser (PD, 10.0 Hz) acting through amplitude asymmetry (roll), mean stroke angle (pitch), drag asymmetry (yaw); stands in for halteres + steering muscles (not connectome)
pitch -> stroke-plane tilt up to 25 deg; yaw -> target yaw rate up to 400 deg/s
takeoff >= 0.5 -> escape sequence: jump impulse 6.1 g for 6 ms (elevation 70 deg) + T2 leg extension, wings start after 4 ms (all values hand-chosen)
wing joint kinematics (sinusoidal stroke + rotation flips) are for visualisation
model_notes.connectome_decides: only the command (takeoff trigger, thrust, yaw, pitch) via flylab.bridge.rates_to_flight_command; a body that can fly is not evidence of connectome-controlled flight (G4).
not_modelled: unsteady aerodynamics (rotational lift, wake capture, added mass)
sensory feedback to the brain (open loop)

verifier.reason: kinematic=correct (all checks passed), vision=uncertain (observed climb, conf 0.6)
verifier.vision: blind Claude-vision check (claude-opus-5-5; sees neither the expected behaviour nor the kinematics): observed behavior: climb, verdict: uncertain, confidence: 0.6

observations: Tiles 1-2: fly stands on floor, wings starting to move.
Tiles 3-4: floor horizon drops in frame; camera view rises, fly appears above floor with wings beating.
Tiles 5-16: floor appears progressively farther below and smaller checker pattern, fly stays centered with wings beating, indicating it is airborne and gaining height.
No clear lateral rotation of floor pattern indicating a turn; heading roughly constant.
vision_detail.blind: model saw neither the expected behaviour nor the kinematic numbers

ground_truth.evidence: for several types, optogenetic activation in freely moving flies evokes specific behaviors

citation.title: Visual projection neurons in the Drosophila lobula link feature detection to distinct behavioral programs
citation.authors: Wu M, Nern A, Williamson WR, Morimoto MM, Reiser MB, Card GM, Rubin GM.

validation.expected_source: literature: Wu et al. 2016 (gt08, LPLC2 activation -> jumping) and Ache et al. 2019 (gt25, LPLC2 -> GF synapses)
validation.result_type_text: partly emergent: the GF rate arises from the connectome model (LPLC2 -> GF); the GF -> takeoff step is the adapter (circular)
validation.stimulus_text: 150 Hz Poisson activation of all LPLC2 (looming-detector) neurons: upstream sensory stand-in for a looming stimulus, not a rendered looming stimulus
